description: This file defines an interface class 'IPlayerTask' within the 'firebolt::rialto::server' namespace. The class declares a pure virtual method 'execute()' intended for implementation by derived classes to perform specific player task actions. It also deletes copy and move constructors and assignment operators to prevent copying or moving instances.

classes.name: IPlayerTask
classes.description: An interface class for player tasks, requiring derived classes to implement the 'execute()' method.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: A pure virtual method that must be implemented by subclasses to perform the specific task.
